text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... So sleepy.
Anyway, listen to this~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be my day off, right?
And yet, my homeroom teacher was like, 'remedial classes'~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "If you don't take it seriously, I'm going to talk to your Trainer"... is what she said~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Having my parents called in would be super lame, right?
So I worked super hard... Aren't I awesome?

It seemed she couldn't rest well as a result of preparing for the makeup exam.
While praising her hard work, I recommended that she review her studies little by little...
